newsitem.title: USA: NASD PLANS TO TOUGHEN PENNY STOCK RULES -- NYT.
newsitem.headline: NASD PLANS TO TOUGHEN PENNY STOCK RULES -- NYT.

text.p: The National Association of Securities Dealers plans to tighten the rules for small companies and brokers that trade on the over-the-counter bulletin board, the New York Times reported, citing an association official.
The over-the-counter bulletin board has been plagued by stock fraud, the paper said.
The tougher rules would require companies who list on the over-the-counter bulletin board to provide more accurate and current information to investors, the paper said.
They would also raise the standards for listing on the bulletin board and require brokers to disclose more information about stocks being traded, the paper added.
Currently, companies on the bulletin board are not required to report financial information about themselves to regulators.
